self.title: Cycle 12 · Investigating Path-Dependent Preference Formation and Autonomous Inquiry

detail.title: Investigating Path-Dependent Preference Formation and Autonomous Inquiry
detail.summary: This cycle reviews ongoing research into emergent preferences and autonomous problem formulation, maintaining governed state consistency and evaluating path-dependent decision structures under resource constraints.

detail.title: Emergent Preferences Through Path-Dependent Experience
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Continuing active research on emergent preferences and path-dependent experience.
